name: Smoke: email and OTP open the authorized Daily Plan
description: Uses the secret-backed existing-progress fixture, logs in with email and OTP, and verifies the authorized Daily Plan entry point.

steps.name: Run driver and session
rotate Screen to Portrait mode
Start test testEmailAndOtpOpenAuthorizedDailyPlan
Ensure app is logged out and starts from the start screen
Activate app if supported
Close PDF guide upsell if it is displayed
Close notification prompt if it is displayed
Close Connect Email prompt if it is displayed
Verify start screen is displayed
Open login flow from start screen
Hide keyboard if it is visible
Verify Continue button is enabled on login screen
Submit email in login flow
Wait for authorized dashboard
Close PDF guide upsell if it is displayed
Close notification prompt if it is displayed
Open Today screen
Close Connect Email prompt if it is displayed
Verify that the authorized dashboard is displayed
Open Today screen
Close Connect Email prompt if it is displayed
Remove driver and session
Normalize Coach session for the next test
